name: linkage
expr: Z1 = linkage(pdist(X), 'single'); Z2 = linkage(pdist(X), 'complete'); Z3 = linkage(pdist(X), 'average'); Z4 = linkage(pdist(X), 'ward'); Z5 = linkage(X); Z6 = linkage(X, 'single', 'cityblock');
comment: Sig: Z = linkage(Y[, method[, metric]]). When Y is N×D matrix, computes pdist(Y, metric, p) internally; when Y is row vector (pdist output), uses it directly. 7 methods: single/complete/average/weighted/centroid/median/ward. 2026-05-08: tie-breaking aligned with MATLAB R2025b (prefers largest pair lex when distances tie); 3-arg form now routes metric to pdist (was hardcoded euclidean). Bit-identical to MATLAB on probed datasets.
